title: Grateful Dead Live at Indianapolis State Fair Coliseum on 1973-10-27
lineage: MAC >> Reel 7.5 ips Revox A77 Reel @ 7.5 ips >> Revox A77 >> Akai GX636>Apogee Mini Me(24/96)>Apogee Mini Dac(monitoring/mastering)>Lynx One soundcard>Wavelab 5.0>FLAC

ai_review.summary: A lively audience recording captures a country‑rock‑heavy show with standout moments like Nobody's Fault, Loose Lucy and Wharf Rat > Stella, while the sound is decent but not pristine.
ai_review.review: The concert rolls through a solid setlist that leans heavily into the Dead’s country side, highlighted by tight renditions of “Nobody’s Fault”, a funky “Loose Lucy” and the seamless “Wharf Rat > Stella” transition. The audience tape isn’t crystal‑clear – reviewers call it decent, better than many early soundboard tapes, and full of live ambience – but it delivers enough presence to make the performance feel immediate.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5‑star or 4‑star) praise the musical performance and note several standout songs; recording quality is described as decent/good but not exceptional, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity with some imperfections; praised for capturing live ambience and being preferable to many early soundboard recordings, though not the highest fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show leans toward a country‑rock feel with smooth transitions (e.g., Big River into Playing Reprise, Wharf Rat into Stella) and maintains an upbeat pacing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Emotive vocals and beautiful guitar work especially on Sugaree are highlighted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux is noted as being “on fire” at the piano.
